This page indexes skill groups and short skill names from their title identifiers. Group associations preserve the structure of that source, not a tested progression model.

For originally summarized numeric skill claims, see [[Game mechanics]]. A localization-described bonus is not proof of the runtime formula, stacking rule, or unlock requirement.

'''Spoilers:''' names and group associations can reveal progression options before you encounter them. No full skill descriptions are copied here.
